now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#40
now.text: Dazzler flirts with Scott and kisses him in front of Jean, then helps him fight off the Hellfire Club.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A singer who flirts with Scott.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Dazzler flirts with him in front of Jean.

proposed.text: Dazzler flirts with Scott and kisses him in front of Jean, then helps him fight off the Inner Circle's men.

changes.evidence: X-Men: The Animated Series #40 (Dark Phoenix Part I, 'Dazzled'): Dazzler kisses Scott in front of Jean and fights off the men attacking him, then tells him where the Inner Circle's headquarters is. The series renamed the Hellfire Club the Inner Circle (Club) for a children's show, so 'Hellfire Club' is never said on screen. Wikipedia's episode list also calls them the Inner Circle Club.

owner_calls.question: Tom and Sean Cassidy: brothers or cousins? Right now the Network says both. This pair says brothers, but the Banshee|Juggernaut stage (XTAS#31) says 'Sean's cousin Tom'.
options: Brothers everywhere (marvelanimated: the series made them siblings), so change Banshee|Juggernaut to 'Sean's brother Tom'
Cousins everywhere (Wikipedia's #31 summary: 'Tom's cousin Sean'), so change this pair's text and both card lines
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia's Phoenix Saga Part III summary says 'Tom's cousin Sean'. marvelanimated's Banshee page says 'Sean and Tom were made siblings in the series rather than cousins as in the comics', and its Black Tom page says 'brother'. The sources disagree, so I changed nothing.

owner_calls.question: The series never uses the name 'Mastermind': he is only ever called Jason Wyngarde. Should the stage text ('Apocalypse imprisons Mastermind...') and the card line 'Mastermind's captor.' use 'Jason Wyngarde' or 'Jason' instead? The node's own name and its desc ('member of the Hellfire Club') have the same problem, since the show calls it the Inner Circle.
options: Rename to Jason Wyngarde in the stage, the card and the node
Keep 'Mastermind' as the app's node name
owner_calls.evidence: marvelanimated's Jason Wyngarde page says 'Wyngarde goes by the name Mastermind, but he doesn't use it in the series.' In #66 (Beyond Good and Evil Part 4) he appears only in a cameo among the captive psychics.

owner_calls.question: The XTAS#37 stage calls him 'Alex Summers' and calls him Scott's brother as fact. The show never says they are brothers, and the name Alex is first said in X-Men '97 #12. Should the stage text and Havok's card use 'Havok' instead of 'Alex' and keep the brother line?
options: Use 'Havok' in the #37 text and card line, and keep the brother line
owner_calls.evidence: marvelanimated's Havok page says 'It is not stated that Havok is Scott's brother' (it is only hinted at in their fight) and 'Havok's real name Alex Summers was mentioned by Polaris in X-men 97 Season 2 episode 2.'
